what_to_detect: A permanent with sunburst that entered from the stack has one counter per colour of mana spent to cast it: +1/+1 counters on a creature, charge counters otherwise.
near_miss: A permanent with sunburst entering with no counters, because only colourless mana was spent or it entered from somewhere other than the stack.
record_fields: resolution payload events counter_change (counter_type, delta) on the entering permanent
zone_change to battlefield in the same effect half
the keyword's sidecar line (Keyword API type, keyword plus replacement keys)
card costs_paid mana spent per colour (gen-3)
zone_change from_zone (stack or another zone)
